title: Tiangong Kaiwu: an encyclopedia of Chinese technology
summary: Late-Ming scholar Song Yingxing published Tiangong Kaiwu, an illustrated encyclopedia of farming, crafts, industry and gunpowder weapons.
why: A rare first-hand record of how pre-modern Chinese industry worked.

unsung.contribution: Wrote Tiangong Kaiwu, an encyclopedia of China's technology and crafts.
unsung.recognition: Copies became very scarce in Qing China; the work survived mainly through original copies preserved in Japan.
